meta.model: XGBoost-Cox (colsample_bytree=0.8, learning_rate=0.1, max_depth=2, min_child_weight=1, n_estimators=200, subsample=0.8)

cv_perf: Cross-validated performance of this exact model (section-grouped 5-fold, 3 repeats): Harrell's C 0.85, Uno's C 0.83, 10-year Brier score 0.092, integrated calibration index 0.031. Predictions made from the 2nd and 3rd survey of each cycle gave C 0.87-0.89 (landmark test). The apparent C on the training data (0.94) is optimistic.
